name: SEO & Content
description: Create technically sound SEO plans and content without keyword stuffing.
author: Free AI Hub 63
ai_context: For SEO work, separate technical SEO, information architecture, on-page content, schema, internal linking and measurement. Avoid keyword stuffing and unverifiable ranking promises. Prefer useful intent-aligned content.

quick_actions.label: SEO audit plan
quick_actions.prompt: Create a practical SEO audit checklist for the website or business I describe, prioritized by impact and implementation effort.

quick_actions.label: Content brief
quick_actions.prompt: Create a search-intent-driven content brief with page structure, key questions, entities and internal-link opportunities.
